title: Notifications
settingsIntro: Choose how you want to hear about things. Some notices are required and cannot be switched off.

roles_changed.title: Your roles were changed
roles_changed.settingsHelp: When an administrator changes your roles or permissions.

requested.title: Leave request
requested.textAuto: {{name}} is absent from {{from}} to {{to}} (no approval needed).
requested.settingsHelp: When somebody asks you to approve leave, or a colleague of yours reports an absence.

decided.title: Leave request decided
decided.settingsHelp: When your leave request is approved or rejected.

cancelled.title: Leave cancelled
cancelled.textApprover: Your leave ({{from}} – {{to}}) was cancelled by an approver.

corrected.title: Attendance corrected
corrected.textCreated: A time record on {{date}} was added for you.
corrected.textUpdated: Your time record on {{date}} was changed.
corrected.textDeleted: Your time record on {{date}} was removed.
corrected.settingsHelp: When a manager or HR adds, changes or removes one of your time records.

assigned.title: Added to a project
assigned.text: You were added to the project “{{projectName}}”.
assigned.settingsHelp: When somebody puts you on a project.

unknown.title: New notification
unknown.text: Open the app to see the details.
